description: Election Commission - Revision of Electoral Registers, Notice of the Election Commission Regarding the Display of 2024 (1), 2024 () and 2024 (3) Supplementary Lists Submission of Claims and Objections as Per the Registration of Electors Act
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively concerns electoral processes, specifically the revision of electoral registers, display of supplementary lists, and procedures for submitting claims and objections related to voter registration. It is issued by the Election Commission and falls under the definition of "Elections Gazettes" which cover electoral boundary changes, voter registration matters, and electoral commission decisions.
